_comment: Pinned model artefacts. Every hash here was produced by fetching the URL
and running sha256 over the bytes, on 2026-08-23. A mismatch at load time
is a hard failure: see src/faciometry/models/weights.py for why it is never
downgraded to a warning and never resolved by editing this file.

yunet.note: Pinned to the opencv_zoo commit that last touched this file rather than to main, which moves. WIDER Face val AP 0.834 / 0.824 / 0.708.

spiga_wflw.note: The author's own Hugging Face mirror. Upstream serves this through Google Drive, whose uc?export=download endpoint returns an HTML virus-scan interstitial for a file this size instead of the file. The Drive copy was fetched through the confirm form and hashes identically, so this mirror is the same bytes with a stable URL.

mediapipe_face_landmarker.note: Bundle of detector, mesh and blendshape models. float16/1 is the versioned path Google publishes; the bundle carries the same Apache-2.0 terms as the code.

sixdrepnet_300wlp.note: Author's institutional share; the URL carries no version, so this hash is the only guard against a silent republish. Trained on 300W-LP, which is rendered from the Basel Face Model, so the inherited obligation is recorded on the Provenance rather than here.
